requirements.text: Students should be able to manage their loans online, including borrowing, returning, and renewing items, while viewing due dates and fines.
The system should automatically calculate fines for overdue items but allow for human oversight to handle exceptions when valid reasons arise.
The study room booking feature should enable students to easily select dates, times, and room sizes, while allowing for personal management of issues like double bookings.
Security and compliance regarding student accounts and personal data must be prioritized.
